goal: Build Circuit Sprint 3D, an original browser-based 3D overhead racer. Return a complete track module that can be reviewed and integrated by Codex.

tasks.objective: Write complete src/track.js as a JavaScript ES module. Create a continuous original road with curbs, grass, and a start line, then expose nearest-road-point lookup.
interfaces: Import * as THREE from 'three'; export function createTrack(scene).

Return { samples, halfWidth, start, nearest, onRoad }. samples is an ordered closed loop of at least 180 {x,z} points; halfWidth is road half-width. start is {x,z,yaw}; car forward is (sin(yaw),cos(y)).
nearest(x,z) returns {x,z,tangentX,tangentZ,distance,progress,index}; progress is 0..1. onRoad(x,z) tests distance <= halfWidth.
acceptance_checks: Road, curbs, ground, and start line use original procedural Three.js geometry; no external assets.
nearest returns usable tangent and progress everywhere on the loop.
Valid JavaScript for Three.js 0.186.0; return only raw module source.
tasks.context: World axes: XZ ground and Y up. The tilted overhead camera shows the full track. The caller owns cars and race rules.
